attempts.summary: Deployed a Python2 inventory web application (systemd service inventory-app.service) on node2 and node3, each listening on 0.0.0.0:8080 and returning JSON inventory data plus its own hostname. Configured node1 with a Python2 round-robin reverse-proxy load balancer (systemd service inventory-lb.service) listening on port 80, forwarding to both backends. Firewalld ports opened (8080 on node2/node3, 80 on node1). Verified round-robin distribution across both backends. Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, then node1 (LB last), confirming boot_id changes and full service/data recovery (and end-to-end LB round-robin) after every restart.
